verticalFaqs.question: Does Chiefy work with all the vendor coordination emails?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Chiefy learns your vendor contacts, preferred vendors, and how you communicate with each one. It categorizes vendor emails by wedding and drafts replies with the right details — confirmations, follow-ups, timeline updates. You review and send. It handles florists, caterers, venues, DJs, photographers, and every other vendor in your rolodex.

verticalFaqs.question: I'm on-site at weddings and venues all day. Will I miss new inquiries?
verticalFaqs.answer: That's exactly what Chiefy solves. When a couple emails asking about availability or packages while you're coordinating on-site, Chiefy drafts a warm, professional reply with your real availability and next steps. You review and send whenever you're free — even from your phone between events. Most planners tell us it saves them 1-2 hours of email time per day during peak season.
